description: GRIDWATCH. A static site served as-is (no build, no dependencies): classic.html is the frozen legacy game (index.html redirects to next.html), sim/ is the pure v4 core (see sim/README.md), content/ holds scenarios as data. `node --test` runs tests/*.test.js (the whole suite: before a merge, and in CI); `npm run test:changed` runs only the test files a change can affect (the inner loop). Statistics over many seeds are tools, not tests: tools/par.js, tools/follow.mjs, tools/baseline-v4.js.
